title: When Evaluators of AI Agents Disagree: An Empirical Study of Native Scoring, LLM Judges, and Commit-Boundary Checks on tau2-bench
abstract: arXiv:2611.14581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic workflows, in which a large language model (LLM) calls tools to read and write data, are evaluated in two ways. Benchmarks compare the final state against a gold answer. Deployed services have none; an LLM judge reads the transcript and decides. Practice treats the two as interchangeable. This paper measures whether they are.   We ran 2,160 episodes in tau2-bench's airline and retail domains and recorded every database write. We scored each episode four ways: native scoring against gold state, an LLM judge, that judge given the policy document, and the boundary evaluator, a minimal rule-based check of whether a write was expected against whether one occurred in the trace. Two annotators independently labeled 120 episodes for task correctness, policy compliance, and commitment correctness. translated_title: 当AI智能体的评估者意见不一致时：基于tau2-bench的原生评分、LLM裁判与提交边界检查的实证研究
translated_abstract: 智能体工作流（即大语言模型（LLM）调用工具来读写数据）有两种评估方式：基准测试将最终状态与黄金标准答案进行比较；而已部署的服务没有黄金标准，由LLM裁判阅读对话记录并做出判断。实践中这两种方式被视为可互换的，本文则实测了它们是否真的可以互换。我们在tau2-bench的航空和零售领域运行了2,160个回合，并记录了每一次数据库写入。我们用四种方式对每个回合进行评分：针对黄金状态的原生评分、LLM裁判、提供政策文档后的LLM裁判，以及边界评估器——一种基于规则的最小化检查，用于比对轨迹中预期应发生的写入与实际发生的写入是否一致。此外，两名标注者独立地对120个回合进行了任务正确性、政策合规性和承诺正确性的标注。结果显示，LLM裁判在98.2%的情况下能重复其判定结果，但与原生评分的一致率仅为56.2%；在11个回合中，智能体执行了被禁止的写入……
tldr: 该论文通过在tau2-bench上进行2,160个回合的实证研究发现，LLM裁判与原生评分的判定一致率仅56.2%，且无法可靠识别智能体的违规写入，证明基准评分与LLM裁判评估在实践中不可互换。
en_tdlr: Through 2,160 episodes on tau2-bench, this empirical study shows that LLM judges agree with native scoring only 56.2% of the time and fail to reliably detect forbidden writes, demonstrating that benchmark scoring and LLM-judge evaluation are not interchangeable in practice.
